commits.message:
test: add edge-case boundary-condition fixtures for off-by-one, zero-length, and single-iteration inputs

- Fix LINT_METADATA: separate LOOP_INVARIANT_STORAGE_ACCESS and UNBOUNDED_INPUT_LOOP into their own entries with proper categories
- Add edge-case fixtures: zero-iteration loops, single-iteration loops, single-char symbol, 10-char boundary
- Add zero-iteration storage_key_construction variant
- Regenerate .stderr files to match updated fixture output

Closes #28

fix: resolve CI compilation errors in cargo-cost-lint

- Define missing BudgetConfig struct with Deserialize derive
- Add missing closing brace to load_budget_config function
- Add HashMap and Deserialize imports
- Remove duplicate list_lints field from Cli struct
- Fix broken match preflight block (remove invalid Option arms)
- Fix format string escaping ({{{ to {{{{)
- Fix build.rs to write LINT_INFO to lint_names.rs (was constructed but never written)
- Collapse nested if-let chains to satisfy clippy::collapsible_if
- Suppress dead_code warnings for BudgetConfig and parse_budget_config
